name.value: Tsideldel Gas Station and General Stores

description.value: Tsideldel Gas Station and General Stores is a combined fuel stop and general store serving the remote Tsideldel community in BC's Cariboo-Chilcotin region. For touring cyclists crossing the sparsely populated Chilcotin Plateau, this is a rare resupply point in a stretch of road with very few services. The combination of fuel, general merchandise, and its location in a small First Nations community makes it a notable waypoint on long-distance rural routes.
